history_status: ALL_PREVIOUSLY_SEEN_DEVELOPMENT; repeated validation selection and inspection of diagnostic tests are development contamination, not independent OOS

scheduler.continuation: close batch, request compact AI critique of completed prior train/validation, consume any ready AI proposals, fill remaining slots with explicitly local novel K configurations, freeze successor before any frequency or backtest result
scheduler.quota_reset: calendar day in Europe/Paris renews operational allowance only; never delete reservations, genes, hypotheses, scientific attempts or selection history
scheduler.idle: IDLE_NO_AUTHORIZED_NOVEL_WORK only when global K space and all ready authorized work are exhausted; waiting for a daily/monthly budget or API response is a distinct WAIT state

api.input_bound: ASCII wire JSON UTF-8 byte count plus 256 framing tokens; reject above 6500; verify provider usage after response
api.accounting: one append-only shared reservation before EVERY transport including rejected calls and retries; reserve max input/output at current documented peak prices; never refund these conservative reservations; unknown transport outcome retains full reservation and is not retried
api.pricing_guard: parse official Flash table before paid work, use max peak/off-peak rates, preserve quote hash; unknown or malformed pricing pauses paid work while local work continues
api.wire: two compact parents at most, prior train/validation numeric metrics and training frequency, finite enum schemas and bounded duplicate examples; no histories, diagnostic results, growing hash lists, secrets or code
api.legacy_budget: old 14-call/112000-token/0.20-USD lifetime budget remains exhausted and immutable; new shared account has its own immutable identity

hypotheses.schema: existing anomaly family/threshold/horizon/action enums and existing Phase2 K gene enums; no arbitrary code or new data sources
hypotheses.ai_response: exact JSON evaluation string and at most two proposals; each proposal exactly parent, rule, genes, mechanism, falsification
hypotheses.identity: configuration hypothesis hash of canonical rule plus canonical genes; ignore wording/parent/source/version; genes deduplicated independently across all predecessors and scheduler lifetime
hypotheses.mechanism_identity: canonical anomaly rule hash separately reused across configurations; all 66 existing rules were already seen; a changed parameter is a new configuration, never automatic proof of a market discovery
hypotheses.mapping: anomaly occurrence is a diagnostic association for a mechanism-inspired K portfolio; unchanged K evaluator tests the K configuration, not equivalence to the anomaly-triggered strategy
hypotheses.provenance: AI_AUTHORED proposals must match the stored raw provider response exactly; deterministic neighbors/enumeration have LOCAL provenance and are never credited to AI
hypotheses.frequency: reuse exact same-input/window bounded_onset_v2 frequency once per rule, or compute it after batch freeze; retain exposure denominators, sparsity and dependency caveats
hypotheses.selection: AI and local parent ranking consume ONLY completed train/validation and frequency ending by feedback_cutoff; diagnostics never enter mutation selection

statistics.primary_endpoint: positive median 30-day costed K portfolio log-growth difference versus BTC_HALF
statistics.null_assumption: conditional independent fair signs across calendar blocks; arbitrary within-block and cross-asset dependence; temporal independence is unverified
statistics.claim: conditional-null contaminated development diagnostic only; never confirms a trading candidate
statistics.alpha: 0.05/[t*(t+1)] with inherited t=1444; reserve one new position before each unique candidate, including invalid/uninformative outcomes; no reset by batch/day/month
statistics.feasibility: freeze exact p-resolution/critical successes/power using each batch's actual lifetime index before results; infeasible or low-power inference remains labelled and does not stop exploratory computations

data_policy.identity: reuse prospectively declared quarantine of unresolved @ identity segments; no certified PIT completeness claim
data_policy.quality: 61 contiguous valid bars; no gap filling; native read-only inputs never mutated; candidate missing-held-price or invalid-held-candle receipt is terminal for that candidate only
data_policy.luna: original daily result remains UNDEFINED_INVALID; archive prices do not invent an executable halt exit or lossless CASH
data_policy.sealed: guarded development-only input reader; worker and broker cannot access prospective collector state

freeze: immutable contract/code/input/bootstrap binding; append-only global registries/reservations; every batch records rules, origin, feedback hashes, train/validation/diagnostic windows, frequency method, alpha and statistical design before results
status: computing means a live bounded phase lease plus observed progress/counters; enabled timers alone never establish active computation
